name: spike-hub-do
description: Spike S-01/S-03 (docs/AFTERPLAY-2.0.md §20.1): Drizzle sobre el SQLite de un Durable Object, solo en local. Sin dependencias propias: reutiliza node_modules de la raíz (drizzle-orm, drizzle-kit, @libsql/client, tsx) y wrangler de worker/node_modules.

scripts.generate: node ../../node_modules/drizzle-kit/bin.cjs generate --config drizzle.hub.config.ts && node ../../node_modules/drizzle-kit/bin.cjs generate --config drizzle.client.config.ts
